answer: The zephyr schedule is applied in signal and delta exposes each instalment. An farming party as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3926 identities would post 1379 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
